title: South Korea moves to cap crypto exchange shareholder stakes at 20%: Report
summary: South Korea’s government and ruling party reportedly agreed on a proposal to cap major shareholder stakes in crypto exchanges at 20%, with limited exemptions for new operators.

title: XRP price breakout targets $1.95 amid five-day ETF inflow streak
summary: XRP analysts highlighted the potential for a rebound to $1.95 as the price broke above a symmetrical triangle amid persistent institutional demand.

title: Three Bitcoin signals show $80K is next BTC price target for bulls
summary: A symmetrical triangle breakout and an unfilled CME gap are boosting the case that Bitcoin may revisit $80,000 in March.

title: Kraken wins Kansas City Fed approval for limited master account access
summary: In a first for crypto, Kraken’s banking unit gained access to the US Federal Reserve’s payment system, Fedwire, though without full banking privileges such as interest on reserves.

title: Iran’s largest crypto exchange shows no clear signs of capital flight: TRM
summary: TRM said a post-strike spike in Nobitex wallet activity looked like routine liquidity moves, even as Chainalysis flagged higher outflows from Iranian exchanges overall.

title: FATF flags stablecoin P2P transfers as sanctions evasion risk
summary: The international watchdog says P2P stablecoin transfers via self-custody wallets can bypass AML checks and urges countries to assess risks and apply proportionate safeguards.

title: Ex-OpenAI researcher’s hedge fund reveals big Bitcoin miner bets in new SEC filing
summary: Leopold Aschenbrenner’s hedge fund Situational Awareness LP has scaled to $5.52 billion in equity exposure in less than a year by betting on power, data centers and Bitcoin miners.

title: Bitcoin price nears one-month high as bulls propel BTC toward $72K
summary: BTC price upside returned during Wednesday's Asia trading session as Bitcoin attacked a long-term trend line and psychological levels.

title: X introduces 90-day revenue-sharing ban for undisclosed AI war videos
summary: Creators posting AI-generated war footage without disclosure risk losing access to X’s revenue-sharing program for three months.

title: US spot Bitcoin ETFs add $225M as BlackRock’s IBIT offsets redemptions
summary: BlackRock’s spot Bitcoin ETF drew $322 million in inflows Tuesday, offsetting outflows from rival funds including Fidelity and Grayscale.
